correctness.rationale: A literal multiset of component strings is a sufficient state. For each ordered pair of distinct component positions the proper overlap is tested; all maximizers, including zero if necessary, receive equal conditional mass and are counted separately even when leading to the same next state. Each transition reduces component count by one, so exact rational recursion over the resulting states is exhaustive. Fresh literal replay, not the frozen endpoint reduction, evaluated 418 states and exactly reproduced every listed mass, normalized to one. Weighting by length gives 3209609/249480. No output above 17 occurs; one legal path to 17 uses overlaps 3,3,3,3,2,1,0 and ends at 00001000100110101. A word of length m has m−3 four-mer positions, so eight distinct four-mers require m≥11, attained by 00101000011. Thus length 17 alone exceeds (3/2)·11. Reversal reverses every ordered pair and its merged word, while complementation preserves pair order; each maps maximal-overlap choices bijectively at every state and preserves probabilities.
residual_risks: The exhaustive law is for the specified eight reads and stagewise uniform ordered pairs, not a fixed random priority over all future ties, arbitrary instances, or biological sequence data.

value.rationale: The instance is motivated by the smallest strict 3/2 binary four-mer obstruction and the sharp extremal ratio, not by selecting a random small parameter slice. The exact stochastic invariant determines the robustness of that genuine worst-case obstruction to a natural tie rule: the failure probability is about 0.698%, and the full law quantifies the other outputs. This is additional usable benchmark data for randomized tie behavior, not a recomputation of the deterministic maxima.
residual_risks: This is a benchmark for one symmetry orbit under a specified tie rule, not an average-case theorem for all four-mer inputs or all randomized Greedy implementations.
